title: Initial-cut capability
intent_and_why: Deliver one evidence-supported current wave without making future outcomes binding.
definition_of_done: The current wave has completed its named exit criteria.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: State the quality boundary that cannot be traded away.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: State the evidence sufficient to accept or falsify this cut.
good_enough.appetite: State the time or complexity appetite for the initial wave.

exit_criteria: Required behavior is demonstrated through the public interface.
